Today of an empty gym behind it

start: Prospect opens the sign-up link app.mettleup.fit/start from the website

steps.action: Open /start, fill the form, create the gym
user_sees: The set-up form first (title 'Start your gym')
After Create my gym the address is the app's own (/)
'Your gym is ready'
must_not: A refresh after sign-up opens the sign-up form again
The sign-in tab hidden with no way to reach it ('Already use MettleUp?' 'Sign in' must be there)

start: Set up a new gym form

steps.action: Type a one-letter gym name and tap the main button
user_sees: 'Type your gym’s name.'
must_not: A gym created

steps.action: Fill all, PIN 123456
user_sees: 'That PIN is too easy to guess. Don’t use one digit six times, digits in order like 123456, or the end of your mobile number.'
must_not: A weak PIN accepted

steps.action: Use a good PIN, leave the terms box empty, tap the main button
user_sees: 'Tick the box to agree to the terms. Then tap “Verify with WhatsApp”.' (or '… Then tap “Create my gym” again.' once the number is checked)
must_not: A gym made without the tick
A WhatsApp check started without the tick

steps.action: Type the mobile number of a person who already owns a gym, verify and create
user_sees: A plain message that this number already has a gym, with 'Sign in instead'
must_not: A second gym made silently for the same number
The other gym's name shown before the number is proven

start: Set up a new gym, number checked by WhatsApp but gym not yet created

steps.action: Change the mobile number after it was verified, tap the main button
user_sees: The button is 'Verify with WhatsApp' again for the new number
must_not: The proof of the first number used for the second number

steps.action: Wait until the check runs out, then tap 'Create my gym'
user_sees: A message that the check ran out, and the check starts again
must_not: A stuck 'Setting up…'
A gym made on a used or expired proof

steps.action: After the gym is made, close 'Your gym is ready', sign out, sign in again
user_sees: The gym opens straight; no 'Your gym is ready' sheet; no terms question
must_not: Asked to agree to the terms a second time for the same version

start: Set up a new gym form and the terms tick

steps.action: Read the form and tap the 'Terms' and 'Data agreement' links
user_sees: Both open as pages without losing what was typed
'Your members and payments are kept online. They stay safe if a phone or computer breaks.'
must_not: The typed PIN shown in clear
The form emptied after reading the terms

steps.action: Create the gym
user_sees: The acceptance is kept once (version, time) for the gym
must_not: The mobile number kept in clear in the WhatsApp check table after the proof is handed out
The PIN stored other than as a hash

start: Sign-in form, owner types a wrong PIN

steps.action: Type the right number and a wrong PIN, tap 'Sign in', several times
user_sees: A line that the PIN or code is wrong, with '(N tries left)'

Unlimited tries

steps.action: Type a 5-digit PIN
user_sees: 'Type your 6-digit PIN, or the code your gym owner gave you.'
